_about: Measure the CENTRING points the textbooks name, on each model, for the Trainer. Rest-frame cm from the volume centre.

mcp3Joint.how: the joint space along the 3rd ray: the deepest dip in bone between the metacarpal head and the proximal phalanx
mcp3Joint.guide: PA and PA oblique hand: CR perpendicular to the 3rd MCP joint (Bontrager; Radiopaedia)

mcp2Joint.how: the joint space along the 2nd ray: the deepest dip in bone between the metacarpal head and the proximal phalanx
mcp2Joint.guide: Lateral hand: CR perpendicular to the 2nd MCP joint (Bontrager; Radiopaedia)

midcarpal.how: the middle of the carpus (the midcarpal landmark: 2 cm proximal of the carpometacarpal level), on the line of the 3rd metacarpal (the capitate)
midcarpal.guide: PA, PA oblique and lateral wrist: CR perpendicular to the midcarpal area (Bontrager; Radiopaedia)

mc3Base.how: the 3rd metacarpal at the carpometacarpal level: bone within 0.7 cm of the 3rd ray
mc3Base.guide: 3rd metacarpal axis (base to MCP joint), for the hand/wrist alignment criterion

radiusDistal.how: the centroid of the radius (the larger forearm bone) 2 cm proximal of the radiocarpal joint
radiusDistal.guide: distal radius axis, for the hand/wrist alignment criterion

radiusProx.how: the centroid of the radius (the larger forearm bone) 5 cm proximal of the radiocarpal joint
radiusProx.guide: distal radius axis, for the hand/wrist alignment criterion

scaphoid.how: the radial-most 1.5 cm of carpal bone 1 cm distal to the radiocarpal joint: the scaphoid
scaphoid.guide: PA axial scaphoid: CR 10-15 degrees proximally, toward the elbow, to the scaphoid, hand in ulnar deviation (Bontrager; Radiopaedia)

intermalleolar.how: midway between the measured medial and lateral malleoli
intermalleolar.guide: AP, AP mortise and AP oblique ankle: CR perpendicular to a point midway between the malleoli (Bontrager; Radiopaedia)

medialMalleolus.guide: Lateral (mediolateral) ankle: CR perpendicular to the medial malleolus (Bontrager)

mt3Base.how: the middle third of the foot bone 43-51 % of the way from the ankle to the tip of the toes (19.2 cm): the base of the 3rd metatarsal
mt3Base.guide: AP foot: CR 10 degrees toward the heel to the base of the 3rd metatarsal; AP medial oblique foot: CR perpendicular to the base of the 3rd metatarsal (Bontrager; Radiopaedia)

medialCuneiform.how: the base of the 3rd metatarsal less 2 cm along the foot (toward the heel): the cuneiforms
medialCuneiform.guide: Lateral (mediolateral) foot: CR perpendicular to the medial cuneiform, at the level of the base of the 3rd metatarsal (Bontrager)

mtp3Joint.how: the gap along the 3rd ray between the metatarsal head and the proximal phalanx, 81 % of the way to the tip of the toes
mtp3Joint.guide: AP toes: CR 10-15 degrees toward the heel to the 3rd MTP joint (all toes); AP oblique toes: CR perpendicular to it (Bontrager; Radiopaedia)

calcaneus.how: the bone behind the ankle and below the medial malleolus, its centroid: the body of the calcaneus
calcaneus.guide: Lateral calcaneus: CR perpendicular to a point 2.5 cm inferior to the medial malleolus (the calcaneal body); axial (plantodorsal) calcaneus: CR 40 degrees cephalad to the long axis of the foot (Bontrager)

elbowJoint.how: the elbow joint: 1.5 cm distal of the midpoint of the measured epicondyles
elbowJoint.guide: AP, AP obliques and lateral elbow: CR perpendicular to the mid elbow joint (Bontrager; Radiopaedia)

C4.how: the body of C4, from the vertebra labels of the CT (s1082)
C4.guide: AP axial cervical: CR 15-20 degrees cephalad to C4, the lower margin of the thyroid cartilage; lateral cervical: CR to C4; AP (posterior) obliques: CR 15-20 degrees cephalad to C4 (Bontrager; Radiopaedia)

C1C2.how: midway between the bodies of C1 and C2: the dens and the atlas
C1C2.guide: AP open mouth (C1-C2): CR perpendicular through the centre of the open mouth, to C1-C2 (Bontrager; Radiopaedia)

C7T1.how: midway between the bodies of C7 and T1: the cervicothoracic junction
C7T1.guide: Swimmers lateral (cervicothoracic): CR to C7-T1, about 2.5 cm above the jugular notch (Bontrager; Radiopaedia)

T7.how: T7: the centre of the lung fields (z -11.2 to 16.0), on the midsagittal plane, at the midcoronal plane; 9 cm below the jugular notch gives 7.8
T7.guide: PA chest: CR to the midsagittal plane at T7, the centre of the lung fields; AP thoracic spine: CR to T7, 8-10 cm below the jugular notch (Bontrager; Radiopaedia)

T7mc.how: T7 (as above) on the midcoronal plane: halfway between the front and back of the body at the midline
T7mc.guide: Lateral chest: CR to the midcoronal plane at T7 (Bontrager; Radiopaedia)

T7.how: T7: the centre of the lung fields (z 0.9 to 32.9), on the midsagittal plane, at the depth of the vertebral bodies; 9 cm below the jugular notch gives 19.1
T7.guide: PA chest: CR to the midsagittal plane at T7, the centre of the lung fields; AP thoracic spine: CR to T7, 8-10 cm below the jugular notch (Bontrager; Radiopaedia)

T7mc.how: T7 (as above) on the midcoronal plane: halfway between the front and back of the body at the midline
T7mc.guide: Lateral chest: CR to the midcoronal plane at T7 (Bontrager; Radiopaedia)

crest.how: the level of the iliac crests (mean of the two measured crests), midsagittal, at the depth of the vertebral bodies
crest.guide: AP lumbar spine (35 x 43 cm): CR to the level of the iliac crest, L4-L5 (Bontrager; Radiopaedia)

crestMc.how: the level of the iliac crests on the midcoronal plane
crestMc.guide: Lateral lumbar spine (35 x 43 cm): CR to the level of the iliac crest (L4-L5), centred to the midcoronal plane (Bontrager)

crestCol.how: the level of the iliac crests (L4-L5), midsagittal, at the middle of the depth of the vertebral column from z -15.7 to 1.8: front of the bodies y -1.8, spinous tips y -12.0 (largest vertebra in a 6 cm slab, every 1 cm)
crestCol.guide: Lateral lumbar spine: CR to the level of the iliac crest (L4-L5), centred on the vertebral column (the midcoronal plane on an average adult); collimate to about 20 cm wide, 1" beyond the bodies and spinous processes (Bontrager; Radiopaedia)

T7col.how: T7 (the centre of the lung fields), midsagittal, at the middle of the depth of the vertebral column from z 3.9 to 26.4: front of the bodies y -3.4, spinous tips y -13.2 (largest vertebra in a 6 cm slab, every 1 cm)
T7col.guide: Lateral thoracic spine: CR to T7, centred on the vertebral column; collimate long and narrow to the column (Bontrager; Radiopaedia)
